notes: Native-green focused IEEE 1516.2-2025 user-supplied and synchronization tag data-type category witness. Public Create accepts a reference-typed user tag and an integer64 time synchronization tag, rejects separate schema-valid raw basic data types as InconsistentFOM, and permits valid federation-name reuse. Clauses 6.2.9 and 6.2.10 are mapped directly. FOM and logical-time configuration are adapter-owned. Java provider runtime, tag transport, broader composition, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
